newsitem.title: MONACO: SOCCER-MONACO DENY REAL CONTACTS OVER HENRY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-MONACO DENY REAL CONTACTS OVER HENRY.

text.p: Monaco denied on Thursday they had had any contact with Real Madrid over their brilliant teenager Thierry Henry since November.
"There has never been any contact with Real Madrid, either recently or during the last few days," Jean-Louis Campora, president of the French first division club, said.
"There was merely an exchange of faxes in the month of November about which I spoke to reproach Real that they were not respecting the rules of (European soccer body) UEFA."

Real Madrid, who have courted the striker for some time, told the sports daily L'Equipe that Henry had signed a pre-contract with them and would play for the Spanish club for the next five seasons from June 1997.
But Campora said Monaco expect Henry, still an apprentice, to sign his first professional contract with them soon. His registration has to be with the national football league by January 13.
